description: This file defines the MediaTypeInterface interface for Drupal's media module, specifying methods related to media type entities such as thumbnail queuing, source retrieval, revision creation, and metadata field mapping.

classes.name: MediaTypeInterface
classes.description: Interface for media type entities in Drupal, extending configuration, description, and revision interfaces, with methods for managing media source, revisions, thumbnail queuing, and metadata mapping.

methods.name: thumbnailDownloadsAreQueued
methods.description: Checks if thumbnail downloads are queued for this media type.

methods.name: setQueueThumbnailDownloadsStatus
methods.description: Sets the queue status for thumbnail downloads.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the media source plugin associated with this media type.

methods.name: setNewRevision
methods.description: Configures whether new revisions are created by default for media items of this type.

methods.name: getFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the metadata field mapping for this media type.

methods.name: setFieldMap
methods.description: Sets the metadata field mapping for this media type.
